title: Pages
description: CMS page tree. Add child pages, move and edit them.
lockedHint: The page is read-only or disabled — content fields are locked.
slugFixed: The slug is part of the URL; it stays fixed when the title changes.
navUrlHint: If set, the menu links to this address instead of the page content.

menuVisibility.title: On the public site menu

reasons.sectionRoot: section root, it heads the left menu
reasons.sideNavOff: not shown in the left menu
reasons.parentSideNavOff: a parent is hidden in the left menu
reasons.dropdownNavOff: not shown in the dropdown menus
reasons.parentDropdownNavOff: a parent is hidden in the dropdown menus

location.allHint: In the section's left menu and in the site's dropdown menus (top menu, mobile menu).
location.dropdownOnly: Only in the dropdown menus (not in the left menu)
location.dropdownOnlyHint: Shown in the top and mobile menus, not in the section's left menu.
location.dropdownOnlyRoot: Not available for a section root: the root heads its section in the dropdown menus.
location.noneHint: Shown in no menu. The page opens at its address and appears in the left menu only while it is open.
location.noneRoot: The section will not be listed in the wide-screen hamburger panel. The nav bar, tablet and mobile menus and the footer do not change.
location.sideOnly: This page is shown only in the left menu (a legacy setting). It stays so until you pick an option.

menuVisibility.promotedToRoot: The parent is not shown in this language — the page will appear at the top level of the menu.
menuVisibility.rootPanelHidden: Not listed in the wide-screen hamburger panel. The first {{count}} sections stay on the nav bar.
menuVisibility.hint: Changes reach the site within a few seconds.
menuVisibility.sideNavOpenOnly: Shown in the left menu while the page itself is open.

menuGroupHint: Sibling pages with the same group are shown together in the dropdown menu. It appears in the site's new menu.

validation.titleRequired: The title must be filled in at least one language
validation.menuGroupTooLong: The menu group can be at most {{max}} characters

move.title: Move: {{name}}
move.description: Choose the new parent page and order. The page itself and its children cannot be selected.

delete.title: Delete page
delete.withChildren: Delete the page "{{name}}" and its {{count}} child pages?

assets.title: Attachments
assets.description: Files attached to the page. Documents with the same group label are shown as an accordion on the site.
assets.groupHint: For example a year (2024) — documents in the same group are collected in one accordion on the site.
assets.detachConfirm: Detach "{{name}}" from this page? The file stays in the library.

reorder.locked: Order not changed: the position of “{{name}}” is locked.

managedSection.title: Content of this page
managedSection.linkText: The table or cards come from the {{path}} section, not from the page text.
managedSection.workingPapersText: The papers come from the {{path}} section, not from the page text. Only the page title and the introduction are edited here.
managedSection.monthlyReportsText: The year → month archive (the monthly files) comes from the {{path}} section, not from the page text. The intro and the methodology are edited here.
managedSection.membershipsNote: The memberships are the first table in this page text: organization in the first column, year in the second. The site sorts by year itself, so a new row can go anywhere in the table.
